title: Ultimate Pearl Harbor Circle Island
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Security restrictions at Pearl Harbor will be enforced. Please do not bring large bags or anything that could offer concealment. Storage is available at Pearl Harbor an additional cost

On rare occasions, the Navy unexpectedly suspends shuttle operations to the USS Arizona In such case, you will still be able to visit the many Arizona Memorial exhibits, visitor’s center and park monuments
Dress comfortably, but please remember that shirts and shoes are required on the USS Arizona Memorial; swimsuits not permitted. High heels, dresses and skirts not recommended
Lunch stop en route at the Hale Aloha Buffet, Hukilau Marketplace only. Food and beverage purchases on own
Guide reserves the right to adjust route for maximum visitor enjoyment and safety
Be ready for spur-of-the-moment stops, unexpected views and special sightseeing along the way!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This all-encompassing tour lead by a guide whose knowledge and love of the island will leave you wishing you had time for more!  It’s a great value, including any required admission fees, and we’ll make sure you get lunch!

Stops and drive-by sites on the Ultimate Pearl Harbor Circle Island may include:
 • World War II Valor in the Pacific National Monument
 • USS Arizona Memorial
 • Wheeler Army Airfield/Schofield Barracks
 • Historic Dole Plantation
 • North Shore Surfing Beaches and Koʻolauloa Coast
 • Hukilau Marketplace Complimentary Lunch with Time for Exploration
 • Nu’uanu Pali Lookout
 • Oahu’s Eastern Shoreline Waimanalo, Makapu’u, Sandy Beach
 • Halona Blowhole and Lookout
 • Hanauma Bay Lookout (Closed every Tuesday)
 • Kahala and Diamond Head Slopes
